wp_items.title: Our Programs
wp_items.yoast_title: Our Programs - Addiction Rehab Centres Canada

blocks.text: At Addiction Rehab Ottawa, we understand how troubling and difficult it can be to deal with an addiction. Regardless of if it is you, or someone you care about, addiction affects many people. If you are ready to make a change and overcome the substance that has taken over your life, then we offer a number of addiction treatment programs to help you get over the substance for good.

Regardless of if it is you, or someone you care about, addiction affects many people. If you are ready to make a change and overcome the substance that has taken over your life, then we offer a number of addiction treatment programs to help you get over the substance for good.

blocks.text: We understand that many substances can result in an addiction. We also understand that each person is unique and therefore requires a unique treatment plan. If you are searching for a holistic approach to addiction rehabilitation, then you are in the right place.

blocks.text: Detox Treatment to Begin Your Addiction Rehab
blocks.html: Detox Treatment to Begin Your Addiction Rehab

blocks.text: For many people, the addiction treatment begins with the detox process. For some drug addictions, the withdrawal symptoms are severe and if not properly managed by our professional staff they can often cause serious consequences, including death in some cases. We never recommend that you attempt to detox on your own.

blocks.text: We have a staff made up of professional, trained staff members who can ensure you detox from the drug safely and with minimal withdrawal symptoms. We can also ensure you don’t give in and begin taking the drug again due to the severity of the withdrawal.

blocks.text: Follow-Up Services for Your Long-Term Recovery

Once you have successfully completed our addiction treatment program, we provide ongoing support for your addiction recovery. You never have to feel like you are on your own, since we will help ensure that you get the treatment you need for long-term recovery. If you, or someone you love, suffers from any type of addiction, contact Addiction Rehab Centres Canada today to learn about the treatment options that are available. We are ready to help you start down the path of long term recovery.
